verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs support form-filling, clicking, and navigating via a 'Browser Sandbox' for interactive workflows (firecrawl-docs-3, firecrawl-docs-8), and community comments reference actual CAPTCHA 'solves' being consumed at cost (firecrawl-comm-6), suggesting some automated CAPTCHA handling exists in practice. However, there is no first-party documentation explicitly claiming automatic CAPTCHA bypass or login-wall traversal, and community sentiment flags cost/reliability friction rather than seamless unattended operation. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of CAPTCHA-solving/login automation, and independent hands-on confirmation that it reliably completes login flows without manual steps.
